script: Somebody sent me this video telling me this wasn't a travel. Here, Grayson Allen gathers the ball, taking a gather step which doesn't count. Then he takes his two legal steps on this pump fake move. He then goes for the step through, but here's where he actually travels. If you look closely, he lifts his pivot foot slightly before the step through motion, so the shot should not have counted!
